description: Used in clients for parsing the commandline.
One commandline argument (including data) is one SPA_Type object.

attributes.name: number
description: Defines which option was parsed.
The option numbers are defined as enum in source/common/sge_options.h, e.g.
the -a option has option number a_OPT.
Every option has a unique option number.

attributes.name: argtype
description: If an option has additional arguments the type of the argument,
as defined in source/libs/cull/cull_list.h, enum _enum_lMultiType, e.g.
lStringT for the -N option (defining a job name as string).

attributes.name: switch_val
description: The option as string, e.g. -N.

attributes.name: switch_arg
description: Optional the argument to the option, e.g. for the -N switch the job name.

attributes.name: occurrence
description: @todo Seems to define if an option has arguments or not.
Possible values are defined in source/common/parse_qsub.h (@todo it is *not* qsub specific, move it):
- BIT_SPA_OCC_NOARG
- BIT_SPA_OCC_ARG

attributes.name: argval_lDoubleT
description: If the option argument is a double then this value is the commandline argument (switch_arg) parsed to double.

attributes.name: argval_lUlongT
description: If the option argument is an ulong then this value is the commandline argument (switch_arg) parsed to ulong.

attributes.name: argval_lUlong64T
description: If the option argument is an ulong64 then this value is the commandline argument (switch_arg) parsed to ulong64.

attributes.name: argval_lLongT
description: If the option argument is a long then this value is the commandline argument (switch_arg) parsed to long.

attributes.name: argval_lBoolT
description: If the option argument is a single bool then this value is the commandline argument (first character of switch_arg).
In parsing of the job submission command line it is used to store the scope information,
JRS_SCOPE_GLOBAL, JRS_SCOPE_MASTER, JRS_SCOPE_SLAVE.

attributes.name: argval_lIntT
description: If the option argument is an integer then this value is the commandline argument (switch_arg) parsed to integer.
In parsing of the job submission command line it is used to store the information if requests are hard or soft.

attributes.name: argval_lStringT
description: The commandline argument (same value as the switch_arg attribute)

attributes.name: argval_lListT
description: If the option argument defines a list of items then this attribute contains the parsed list.
